svg.title: From one awb call to an envelope on screen
svg.desc: An agent runs awb task with --msg-to. awb takes the lock (mkdir data/.lock), adds the task update and message, writes board.json.<pid>.tmp, renames it over board.json and releases the lock. server.mjs sees the rename through fs.watch, waits 60 ms for the burst to settle, reads the state and pushes it over server-sent events. The page keeps only new message ids, renders, and in the Office view an envelope flies from the sender's desk to the recipient's.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif
